def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+N]]

    # Fenwick tree size, next power of two <= N for binary lifting
    size = N
    bit = [0] * (size + 1)
    # Initialize: all positions 1..N have value 1. Use O(N) init.
    for i in range(1, size + 1):
        bit[i] += 1
        j = i + (i & -i)
        if j <= size:
            bit[j] += bit[i]

    LOG = 1
    while (1 << LOG) <= size:
        LOG += 1
    LOG -= 1  # highest bit such that (1<<LOG) <= size

    ans = [0] * (N + 1)

        k = P[i - 1]
        # find smallest index pos such that prefix sum >= k
